content: {"doneWhen":{"all":[{"body":{"x":11,"y":1}}]},"modes":[{"id":"fight-adjacent","priority":10,"when":{"all":[{"monsterOnFacedTile":true}]},"macro":"press","params":{"buttons":["ControllerX"]}},{"id":"flee","priority":9,"when":{"all":[{"monsterWithin":2}]},"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"retreat"}},{"id":"navigate-to-ladder","priority":1,"when":{"all":[{"always":true}]},"macro":"skill","params":{"name":"go-to-ladder"}}],"skills":[{"name":"go-to-ladder","skill":"async (b) => { const path = [[2,8],[3,8],[4,8],[5,8],[6,8],[7,8],[8,8],[9,8],[10,8],[11,8],[11,7],[11,6],[11,5],[11,4],[11,3],[11,2],[11,1]]; for (const [x,y] of path) { const r = await b.walkTo(x,y,'stand'); if (!r.ok) { b.log('walk fail '+x+','+y+' '+r.reason); } } }","check":"async (b) => { const p = await b.body(); return {ok: p.x===11 && p.y===1, detail: 'at '+p.x+','+p.y}; }"},{"name":"retreat","skill":"async (b) => { const p = await b.body(); const ms = await b.monsters(); let best=null, bd=1e9; for (const m of ms) { const d=Math.abs(m.x-p.x)+Math.abs(m.y-p.y); if (d<bd){bd=d;best=m;} } if (!best) return; const dx = p.x - best.x, dy = p.y - best.y; let tx=p.x, ty=p.y; if (Math.abs(dx)>=Math.abs(dy)) tx += dx>0?1:-1; else ty += dy>0?1:-1; tx=Math.max(0,Math.min(12,tx)); ty=Math.max(0,Math.min(9,ty)); await b.walkTo(tx,ty,'stand'); }","check":"async (b) => ({ok:true, detail:'retreated'})"}]}
